verdict.rationale: The Drive API supports listing and downloading all files (docs-10/26) and community evidence confirms third-party tools like rclone can pull entire Drive contents and export Google Docs to open ODF formats (comm-5, comm-13), showing data portability is achievable. However, there is no first-party, one-click 'export everything in open formats' feature documented in the evidence pack—only API primitives and reliance on external tooling. Missing for 10: official bulk-export/Takeout-style documentation, native open-format export guarantees for all file types, and independent confirmation of completeness/fidelity of such exports.
